_meta.name: Blossom v2 Value & Pricing Calculator — configuration
_meta.notes: Per-acre tiers. Recommended tier = the highest tier forced by acres, users, or any selected option (mirrors the CustomerValueCalculator 'BBLsNeeded' tab). Legacy migration offer replaces the old 50%/25% ramp.

recommendation.acresDriver: acres > 1000 -> Enterprise; acres > 100 -> Pro; else Starter
recommendation.usersDriver: users > 10 -> Enterprise; users > 5 -> Pro; else Starter
recommendation.optionsDriver: highest minimum tier among selected options
recommendation.recommendedTier: highest rank of the three drivers
recommendation.belowRecommendedWarning: shown when the chosen tier rank < recommended tier rank

legacyMigrationOffer.offer: Pro features at the Starter price ($1.00/acre/mo, $50/mo minimum) for one year (2027); the 100-acre Starter cap is waived.
legacyMigrationOffer.after: From 2028, choose a tier at standard pricing based on acres, users, and options.
legacyMigrationOffer.timing: No migrations before end of 2026 (CranTrak maintained; a rare adamant Blossom v1 mover is handled one-off). Expect a year-end / early-2027 migration wave.

customizationNote: One-time charges; not included in the monthly/annual subscription.
